capabilities: Transcribe embedded images and PDFs into per-source Markdown transcript notes
Refine finished transcripts with prose feedback across versioned rounds
Describe text-sparse images with categories and tags so they turn up in search
Stream model output into a sidebar with per-image cards and a diff gate before overwriting
Configure ordered fallback vision endpoints with keys kept in Obsidian's keychain
extras: The manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice; full documentation follows the Diátaxis framework on an external docs site, with the README covering features, settings, gotchas and security contact.
intentEvidence: Image to Markdown was split out of vault-rag 0.2.0
motivation: The author split it out of the vault-rag plugin because image transcription is not RAG and the two only shared the SSE transport.
problem: Obsidian leaves embedded scans, screenshots and photographed pages as unsearchable images with no built-in way to turn their content into editable Markdown.

relations.evidence: Image to Markdown was split out of vault-rag 0.2.0 on 2026-06-21
If the LLM Endpoint Manager plugin is installed, the endpoints (and their keys) come from it

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible local vision server (e.g. LM Studio)
Per-endpoint API key for hosted providers

summary: Transcribes embedded images and PDFs into Markdown notes using a local OpenAI-compatible vision model, streaming results live into a sidebar.
